vulnerabilityAssessments.reason: Repository commands use Vite only for builds and optional static preview. Browser checks serve compiled fixture files through a fixed Node HTTP file map. No Vite development server, editor-launch middleware, SSR transformIndexHtml request, or dev import-analysis route is exposed. Trace and remediation: [docs/security/dependency-assessment-2026-10-09.md](docs/security/dependency-assessment-2026-10-09.md#addendum-2026-10-23-supported-node-and-development-server-advisories).
vulnerabilityAssessments.impact: The required request-to-API path is absent in the checked-in commands. Reassess before changing server configuration, middleware, mocker plugins, or network exposure.

vulnerabilityAssessments.reason: Vitest runs Node/jsdom suites with hoistMocksPlugin and automockPlugin. Neither Setta nor this Vitest Node runner registers the public mockerPlugin/interceptorPlugin WebSocket handlers that accept attacker-supplied manual mock URLs. Trace and remediation: [docs/security/dependency-assessment-2026-10-09.md](docs/security/dependency-assessment-2026-10-09.md#addendum-2026-10-23-supported-node-and-development-server-advisories).
